tools.name: auth_advertiser_get
tools.description: Get all authorized TikTok advertiser account IDs for the authenticated user. No parameters required. Called first to get IDs for advertiser_info_get.

tools.name: advertiser_info_get
tools.description: Get name and status for one or more TikTok advertiser accounts by ID.

tools.name: page_get
tools.description: List Instant Form pages for a TikTok ad account. Filter by business_type=LEAD_GEN. Do not filter by status. Forms in EDITED (draft) state may still have leads from when they were live.

tools.name: page_field_get
tools.description: Get field definitions for a specific Instant Form. Used to display available fields and support custom mapping guidance.

tools.name: page_lead_task_create
tools.description: Create an async lead export task for an Instant Form (omit task_id), or poll an existing task's status (include task_id). Returns task_id on create; returns status=SUCCEED when complete.
notes: Pass page_id (no task_id) to create a new export task
Pass task_id (no page_id) to poll task status
Regional routing required: use x-lead-region header for EEA/CH/UK (eu) or US (us)
Generated file expires 10 minutes after creation. Download immediately after status reaches SUCCEED.

tools.name: page_lead_task_download
tools.description: Download completed lead export as CSV (<=10MB) or ZIP (>10MB). Task must have status=SUCCEED before calling.
notes: KNOWN LIMITATION: Only supports regions outside EEA, CH, UK, and US. TikTok has confirmed this is a current gap and expects to resolve it in Q3 2026 (possibly July). Surface this clearly to users in affected markets.

tools.name: get_organization_details
tools.description: Verify HubSpot MCP is reachable during onboarding check.

tools.name: get_user_details
tools.description: Verify the user has write access to contacts before starting the sync. Use include: [TOOL_INFORMATION] to check contact write permissions.

tools.name: query_crm_data
tools.description: SQL query to find the most recently created TikTok-sourced contact, used to suggest a smart sync time window default.

example.sql: SELECT createdate FROM CONTACT WHERE hs_analytics_source_data_1 = 'tiktok' ORDER BY createdate DESC LIMIT 1

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find matching HubSpot contact properties for custom TikTok form fields using keyword search.

tools.name: search_crm_objects
tools.description: Search HubSpot contacts by email for deduplication, and by name/phone for fuzzy duplicate detection.

tools.name: manage_crm_objects
tools.description: Create or update HubSpot contacts with mapped lead field values. Also used post-sync to assign contacts to a HubSpot owner.
notes: Requires user confirmation before writing. Obtain session-level approval upfront when syncing multiple leads.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: List active HubSpot owners for post-sync contact assignment. Returns owner IDs and names.
